chapters.title: General ledger, main accounts and categories
Where Power BI and Excel fit

takeaways: Financial reports only read what is posted in the general ledger, so clean main accounts, account types and categories come first.
Use financial dimensions for reusable reporting values like department or region, and financial tags for one-off references like invoice numbers.
Financial reporting builds formal statements from row, column and report definitions, while Power BI and Excel cover interactive analysis and checks.
hook: Month end still means spreadsheet versions and managers waiting for answers that should be obvious. This episode explains, for finance teams and Dynamics 365 newcomers, how posted ledger data becomes readable financial statements in Dynamics 365 Finance. You learn how main accounts, financial dimensions and report definitions work together, and where Power BI and Excel fit.
